verdict.rationale:
Viam's docs describe 'logic modules' explicitly for autonomous background operation — reacting to sensor data, coordinating components, running continuous processes, and scheduling actions — plus fleet-wide monitoring/alerting and OTA management to keep such automations running unattended across many machines (viam-docs-17, viam-docs-38, viam-docs-26, viam-docs-10). Data queuing/sync during outages further supports unattended operation (viam-docs-7).
missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of a real deployed autonomous scheduled automation running reliably in the field, and more detail on scheduling/triggers mechanics beyond a bullet list.
